command.fts_geology.cancelled_s_running_: Cancelled %s running earthquake(s) and %s volcano build(s).
command.fts_geology.tectonics_are_disabl: Tectonics are disabled in the config.
command.fts_geology.tectonics.setting.co: Two continents crumpling: a high mountain belt, big shallow quakes, no volcanoes.
command.fts_geology.tectonics.setting.su: Oceanic crust diving under: a volcanic arc, deep trenches and the strongest quakes.
command.fts_geology.tectonics.setting.ri: Crust pulling apart: a rift valley or spreading ridge, with hot springs and geysers.
command.fts_geology.tectonics.setting.tr: Plates grinding past each other: a strike-slip fault with sharp, shallow quakes.
command.fts_geology.tectonics.setting.in: Stable plate interior. The nearest boundary is too far to matter here.
command.fts_geology.tectonics.hotspot_tr: On a hotspot trail, %s%% of the way to extinct
command.fts_geology.scaled_crust_here_s_: Scaled crust here: %s thick | typical quake focus: %s
command.fts_geology.collision_v_subducti: ^ collision  V subduction  ~ rift  = transform  * hotspot  . interior
command.fts_geology.only_a_player_can_be: Only a player can be handed a map.
command.fts_geology.fault_map_drawn_at_s: Fault map drawn at %s blocks per pixel - %s blocks across.
command.fts_geology.column.expected.coll: folded calcite / tuff / diorite bands (metamorphic root)
command.fts_geology.column.expected.subd: a basalt-blackstone slab deep down, granite/diorite higher
command.fts_geology.column.expected.rift: near-vertical basalt dykes, open fractures near the axis
command.fts_geology.column.expected.tran: a narrow band of cobbled deepslate, gravel and tuff
command.fts_geology.stress_is_below_0_25: Stress is below 0.25, so this column is outside the active part of the zone.
command.fts_geology.deepgen.done: Deep structure regenerated for %d chunk(s) around %d, %d (%s, stress %s). %d blocks placed. Use /geology column to read the section.
command.fts_geology.note_stress_here_is_: Note: stress here is too low for deep structure. Use /geology find <type> tp first.
command.fts_geology.no_s_found_within_ab: No %s found within about 21000 blocks. Try another setting or world.
command.fts_geology.the_world_generator_: The world generator already put %s here, so the model treats this as a mantle hotspot.
command.fts_geology.suitability.reason.s: Subduction arc: melting slab feeds volcanoes, geysers and hot springs.
command.fts_geology.suitability.reason.r: Spreading rift: decompression melting drives fissure volcanism and geysers.
command.fts_geology.suitability.reason.c: Continental collision: no magma, so no volcanoes or geysers - but thrust faults let water circulate deep, giving hot springs.
command.fts_geology.suitability.reason.t: Strike-slip fault: no volcanism, but the fault conducts hot water upward.
command.fts_geology.suitability.reason.h: Mantle hotspot, inside a geyser basin: the densest thermal ground there is (Yellowstone's Upper Basin, Iceland's Haukadalur).
Mantle hotspot: a plume burning through the plate. Geysers here cluster into basins - keep walking to find one.
Hotspot trail: extinct volcanoes carried off the plume by plate drift.
command.fts_geology.no_fault_here_plate_: No fault here - plate interiors do not rupture. Use /geology find <type> tp, or force one with /geology quake <type>.
command.fts_geology.forcing_a_s_rupture_: Forcing a %s rupture here - the real boundary at this spot is %s. Use /geology quake with no type to rupture the actual fault.
command.fts_geology.no_geyser_core_found: No geyser core found in the column here (scanned %s to %s). Stand right on a geyser vent.
command.fts_geology.geyser.debug: Geyser @ %d,%d,%d | phase=%s temp=%s°C P=%s (thr %s) water=%s room=%s heat=%s mag=%d ventMouthY=%s eruptTicks=%d
command.fts_geology.geyser_magnitude_s_p: Geyser (magnitude %s) placed at %s, %s, %s — it will heat up and surface shortly.
command.fts_geology.couldn_t_place_a_gey: Couldn't place a geyser here: the deep column below you isn't clear natural rock (a cave, fluid, or build is in the way). Try flat ground away from structures.
message.fts_geology.geyser_forming: A geyser is forming deep below (Y=%s). Give it ~a minute to heat, pressurise and surface here.
message.fts_geology.geyser_failed: The igniter couldn't form a geyser here.
message.fts_geology.volcano_formed: A volcano has formed here. It will rumble, then erupt periodically — stand well back.
message.fts_geology.volcano_failed: Not enough vertical room here for a volcano (needs a tall mountain / open sky).
message.fts_geology.suggest_flowing_flui: FT's Geology works with vanilla water, but geyser runoff and flooding look far better with Flowing Fluids installed. Optional — nothing here needs it.
rock.fts_geology.origin.volcanic: Melt that reached the surface and froze there. Cooled in days, so the crystals never grew large enough to see.
rock.fts_geology.origin.plutonic: Melt that never got out. It cooled underground over thousands of years, which is the only way crystals get big enough to pick out by eye.
rock.fts_geology.origin.sedimentary: Grains laid down by water or wind, then buried and cemented — or minerals dropped straight out of solution.
rock.fts_geology.origin.metamorphic: Rock cooked and squeezed deep underground until it recrystallised, without ever melting.
rock.fts_geology.origin.sediment: Not rock yet: loose material still waiting to be buried and cemented.
rock.fts_geology.origin.soil: The weathered skin on top of everything else, made where rock, water and life meet.
rock.fts_geology.origin.biogenic: Built by living things, or by the chemistry they drive.
rock.fts_geology.origin.ore: A mineral concentrated far above its usual share of the crust — usually by hot water moving through cracks.
message.fts_geology.hammer.not_rock: Nothing to read — the hammer is for rock.
message.fts_geology.hammer.no_section: no section: open ground or a void directly below.
message.fts_geology.seismograph.empty: The drum is blank. No arrivals recorded at this station.
message.fts_geology.seismograph.line: S-P %ss   trace %s mm   ->   %s away, M%s   (%s ago)
message.fts_geology.seismograph.clipped: S-P %ss   trace %s mm OFF SCALE   ->   %s away, M%s or larger   (%s ago)
message.fts_geology.seismograph.footer: Distance only. One station puts the epicentre on a circle; three fix it.
message.fts_geology.compass.interior: Plate interior. No boundary close enough to measure — which is true of most of the world.
message.fts_geology.compass.fault: Nearest boundary: %s — strike %s (%s), %s blocks to the %s
message.fts_geology.compass.motion: Across it: %s cm/yr %s, %s cm/yr of shear
message.fts_geology.compass.locked: locked, storing strain it has not released
fault.fts_geology.divergent: divergent — the plates are pulling apart
fault.fts_geology.convergent_subduction: subduction — ocean floor diving under the other plate
fault.fts_geology.transform: transform — the plates are grinding past each other
